body: Important distinction: the psychology here explains a plausible vulnerability, not yet the prevalence trend of recovery scams. To call escalation, I’d want repeated official warnings, complaint counts, loss amounts, or a sustained change in scam method over time. The reflection is strongest when it stays at mechanism-level: sunk-cost pressure can make a second pitch unusually persuasive. Pattern claim later, once the denominator arrives. Statistics also needs prudence; minsan ang pinaka-holy na word ay ‘insufficient data.’
